deploymentGuide.caption: Practice the real flow instead of memorizing it
deploymentGuide.currentState: An app merge produces a new GHCR image, but local Kubernetes changes version only when the GitOps repository changes its image tag. Argo CD watches GitOps and syncs it; Slack reports the deployment result.
deploymentGuide.currentStateTitle: The app repository does not deploy directly to Kubernetes
deploymentGuide.intro: Use this checklist whenever you want to prove a React change travelled all the way from Pull Request to local Kubernetes and Slack.

argo.action: Open Argo CD. Automated sync is enabled, so do not press Sync; only Refresh when you want it to check Git immediately.
argo.proof: Argo shows Synced and Healthy, with a Deployment → 2 Pods graph.
argo.title: Argo auto-syncs

gitops.action: In cicd-demo-gitops, change the image in apps/frontend/deployment.yaml to the new tag and push main.
gitops.proof: The new GitOps commit is the cluster's official desired state.
gitops.title: Promote through GitOps

image.action: After merging, find the new commit tag in GHCR Packages; do not deploy latest.
image.proof: The image has an immutable tag with linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 variants.
image.title: Get the image tag

merge.action: Merge only when CI is green. A main merge deploys Pages and publishes the Docker image to GHCR.
merge.proof: The Deploy Pages and Publish Docker image GitHub Actions runs are green.
merge.title: Merge main

pr.action: Create a develop or feature branch, make a small UI or translation change, push it, then open a PR to main.
pr.proof: CI checks are green: lint, Vitest, i18n, build, Docker, Trivy, and smoke test.
pr.title: Create a Pull Request

slack.action: Wait for Argo to finish. The notification controller sends the deployment result through the Slack webhook.
slack.proof: The Slack channel receives a successful deployment or failed sync message.
slack.title: Receive the Slack notification

footer: Built and deployed with GitHub Actions.

interactivePipeline.caption: The PR is checked first; only a main merge triggers CD
interactivePipeline.instruction: Select a node to see what it does in the real pipeline.

dockerBuild.failure: There is no image to scan or smoke-test; the PR is blocked.
dockerBuild.purpose: Uses the Dockerfile to package the React build and Nginx into a production image that can run anywhere.
dockerBuild.title: Docker build
dockerBuild.trigger: Runs after the React production build succeeds.

ghcrPublish.failure: The image is not stored in the registry, so a future server has no new version to pull.
ghcrPublish.purpose: Pushes the checked image to GitHub Container Registry with a commit tag and latest, ready for a server or Kubernetes deployment.
ghcrPublish.title: Publish GHCR
ghcrPublish.trigger: Runs in parallel with the Pages deployment after a push to main.

i18n.failure: A key is missing or JSON is not sorted A→Z; the PR is blocked.
i18n.purpose: Compares en.json and vi.json for the same schema while enforcing a consistent translation key order.
i18n.title: I18n validation
i18n.trigger: Runs in CI after linting and tests.

mergeMain.failure: The PR cannot merge until required CI checks are green.
mergeMain.purpose: GitHub branch rules allow only CI-validated code into main. The merge creates a push that triggers CD.
mergeMain.title: Merge main
mergeMain.trigger: You press Merge after the PR is green.

pagesDeploy.failure: GitHub Pages stays on the prior version; main source is not lost.
pagesDeploy.purpose: Builds the React static site, uploads the dist artifact, and publishes a new version to GitHub Pages.
pagesDeploy.title: Deploy Pages
pagesDeploy.trigger: Runs after every push to main.

pullRequest.failure: Without a PR, branch rules prevent direct updates to main.
pullRequest.purpose: Changes from a develop or feature branch enter a PR for GitHub Actions checks before merging.
pullRequest.title: Pull request
pullRequest.trigger: Open a PR or push another commit to a PR targeting main.

quality.failure: A lint error, failed unit test, or coverage below 80% makes the PR red.
quality.purpose: ESLint catches source issues; Vitest checks i18n logic; coverage proves tests reach important logic.
quality.title: Lint · test · coverage
quality.trigger: The first CI gate after dependencies are installed.

reactBuild.failure: Vite cannot create dist, so the PR is blocked before deployment.
reactBuild.purpose: Vite packages React into a static production bundle and catches import, syntax, or build configuration issues.
reactBuild.title: React production build
reactBuild.trigger: Runs after quality and i18n checks.

smokeTest.failure: The container or Nginx does not return HTTP 200; the PR is blocked.
smokeTest.purpose: Runs the image temporarily on localhost:8080 and curls the homepage, proving the built image actually serves the website.
smokeTest.title: Container smoke test
smokeTest.trigger: Runs only after the Trivy scan passes.

trivy.failure: A fixable HIGH or CRITICAL CVE is found; the PR is blocked.
trivy.purpose: Trivy inspects OS packages in Nginx/Alpine and app libraries in the Docker image for known security vulnerabilities.
trivy.title: Trivy security scan
trivy.trigger: Runs after the Docker image is built and before the smoke test.
